description: Findings of check:person-lifespans (scripts/check/rules/person-activity-after-death.mjs) the owner has reviewed and accepted: a candidacy, vote or office dated after a person's recorded death or before their 18th birthday that is nevertheless right (a candidate who died after nomination and stayed on the ballot, a date of death the reference gives only to the year). Each entry: personId, kind (after-death, before-18, vote-before-first-election, office-ends-after-death), date (optional: without it every finding of that kind for the person is accepted) and reason.

exceptions.reason: Posthumous candidacy: John J. Keane, Fianna Fail TD for Galway West, died on 3 February 1948, the day before polling; his name stayed on the ballot and he is listed among the 1948 candidates with 2,146 first preferences (Wikipedia, "Galway West (Dail constituency)", 1948 results; "John J. Keane (politician)" for the date of death). The candidacy is his.
